main_text.l: נִבְנוֹן m. Eminens, Gibbosus admodum: Plur. נִבְנִנִים.
גִּבְיִים גִּבְיַע m. Scyphus: plur. גִּבְיִעִים.
גָּבַר Valere viribus, Validum, Robustum esse. Pihel גִּבֵּר Validum efficere, Roborare, Corroborare. Hiphil הִגְבִּיר idem. Hithpahel הִתְגַּבֵּר Invalescere, viriliter se gerere.
גֶּבֶר גֶּבֶר m. Vir, à Robore & viribus: plur. ס גְּבָרִים. Chald. גֶּבֶר, גַּבְרָא, גַּבְרָא Vir: plur. גַּבְּרַיָּא גִּבְרִין.
גִּבּוֹר m. Potens, Prepotens. Valens, Validus, Robustus, Fortis: plur. גִּבּוֹרִים Potentes. Chald. גִּבְּרִין.
גֶּבִיר m. Herus, Dominus: Fœm. גְּבִירָה, Domina, Augusta, Hera.
גְּבוּרָה f. Virtus, Potentia, Robur, Fortitudo: plur. גְּבוּרוֹת. Chald. גְּבוּרְתָּא f. Potentia.
גָּבִישׁ גבש m. Unio, margarita pretiosa.
גַּג גַּג m. Tectum: plurale, גַּגּוֹת.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek-looking forms are transcribed approximately; vowel points and some letters in the scan are doubtful, especially in the Chaldaic forms and the plural forms in the entries "גִּבְיִעִים" and "מִגְבָּעוֹרת". The first two Hebrew words of the entry "גִּבְיִים" and the small square-type block after "Gibbosus" are uncertain. Entry "גבש" appears to be a cross-reference printed in the entry line.
